newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil makes small North Sea gas find.
newsitem.headline: Statoil makes small North Sea gas find.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) has made a small gas discovery in North Sea block 35/10 between the Gullfaks and Troll developments, the Norwegian Oil Directorate said on Tuesday.
Exploration well 35/10-2 was drilled to a depth of 4,652 metres below sea level. No production test was made.
The directorate said it was too early to determine the size of the find, but it was likely that it was relatively small.
Partners in exploration licence 173 covering the block are Statoil as operator with 50 percent, Mobil with 20 percent and Norsk Hydro and Elf Aquitaine with 15 percent each.
